To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
RailSLAM can be used as an alternative for GNSS-based localization, if GNSS is not available, and can be used for the creation and maintenance (updating) of a geometric track map.

RailSLAM is a method for simultaneous localization and mapping of rail vehicles and geometric railway tracks based on measurements from a GNSS and an IMU and that the method is able to create a map of the track and localize the train simultaneously.
RailSLAM can be used for localization, mapping and collision avoidance of trains.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and evaluation of a novel localization method for railway applications based on low-cost IMU and GNSS sensors.
the development of a robust and precise localization system for rail vehicles, which is based solely on sensors that are installed in the train itself.
a novel localization method for rail vehicles that is based on low-cost sensors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
RailSLAM is a novel approach for the localization of trains based on a feature map and the simultaneous creation and maintenance of a geometric-topological feature map of the railway network.
the RailSLAM concept and the proof of concept implementation are a promising approach for a robust localization and mapping of railway tracks.
the presented work is a first step to a complete system that allows for a simultaneous localization and mapping approach for trains.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presented approach is a step towards a complete solution for a fully autonomous train, which is a major goal in rail transport.
the localization and mapping problem for railway applications is solved in the context of Simultaneous Localization And Mapping.
we are able to localize a train on the track with an accuracy of a few meters and we are able to map the track geometry and topology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a track map can be created from a moving train using low-cost IMU and GNSS measurements.
a probabilistic track map can be estimated from train-side measurements, which is a prerequisite for many advanced train control systems.
RailSLAM is a viable solution for train localization and track mapping in the harsh conditions of a railway environment.
